_comment: Template for ~/.claude/settings.json. Copy to ~/.claude/settings.json and customize per-machine. Do NOT commit your actual settings.json — gitignored. NOTE: PATs and MCP credentials added via `claude mcp add` live in ~/.claude.json (different file), which is also gitignored from your home dir.
_permissions_comment: Baseline allow/deny applies to all projects via user-scope cascade. Per-project .claude/settings.local.json only needs project-specific additions (MCP tool names, .specify/* scripts, etc.).

sentry._comment: Sentry MCP — replace org slug. Org-scoped covers all projects under the org.
